reasons.population_gates: User 2026-11-12 (grill Q1): T, B, monocyte, NK and DC gates. CD3neg then CD19+ B, CD14+ monocyte, CD56+ NK, and HLA-DR+ then CD11c+ then CD1c+ (DC chain). The populations overlap (a CD14+ cell is usually HLA-DR+ CD11c+). CD1c is both a gate and a readout here, so score the CD1c readout in CD3neg live, never inside CD1cpos. Search window c(0, 3) is my proposal, shown in the density figures for approval. CD1cpos: fixed 1.0, user 2026-11-12 (grill Q3; same value as the CD1c readout cut); user wants the CD1c gate shown (99b_gate_candidates.R). label: plain name of each population, used in figure titles. User 2026-11-13: TCRgd cut = cytoUtils gate_tail on CD3+ cells (0.41, 99b candidate_cuts.csv); CD1c DC cut = negative peak + 4 SD on pooled AS 1.8.8 CD11c+ events (1.2759, 99b candidate_cuts.csv), fixed here so the gate does not move; the CD1c readout cut stays fixed 1.0 (a separate choice).
